correctness.rationale: Spectral characteristic polynomial \(\mu^4-(x+y+z)\mu^2+xz\) yields the exact trace-sixth identity with \(1/32\). At fixed \(m=x^3+z^3\) and y, strict convexity of \(F(u)\) in outer mean u eliminates asymmetric interior maxima. All boundaries have \(F\le4\) (or \(F=1\)), while \(x=y=z\) gives \(F=6\). The remaining \(g(r)\) has derivative \(-6(\(r^4+3r^3-4r-3\))/(r^3+2)^2\) and exactly one positive critical root, giving complete equality classification; 796 exact rational diagnostic assertions replayed successfully.
